decision: Execute the actual browser reader's structured rich-text rendering functions in an isolated Node VM during the normal build to verify escaping, safe link behavior, and rejection of unsupported nodes.
invariants: The test imports no production runtime dependencies beyond Node built-ins.
Tests exercise the current public/app.js renderer source, not a copied reimplementation.
No production source, runtime behavior, database schema, or deployment workflow changes are introduced.
acceptance: Unsafe URL schemes do not produce anchors.
HTTP(S) links include safe rel and target attributes.
Unsupported node types and heading levels return no render output.
A valid versioned structured chapter envelope renders successfully.
